description: A bee farmer transports his honey in small and large bottles. A small bottle can take 5 units of honey while a large bottle can take 20 units of honey. The farmer has available at most 300 small bottles and at most 100 large bottles. In addition, since small bottles are easier to sell, at least twice as many small bottles must be used than large bottles. Finally, he can transport at most 200 bottles total and at least 50 must be large bottles. How many of each bottle should be use to maximize the total amount of honey he can transport?

SmallBottleCapacity.definition: Capacity of a small bottle in units of honey

LargeBottleCapacity.definition: Capacity of a large bottle in units of honey

MaxSmallBottles.definition: Maximum number of small bottles available

MaxLargeBottles.definition: Maximum number of large bottles available

MinRatioSmallToLarge.definition: Minimum ratio of small bottles to large bottles

MaxTotalBottles.definition: Maximum total number of bottles that can be transported

MinLargeBottles.definition: Minimum number of large bottles that must be used

objective.description: "Maximize the total amount of honey that can be transported using small and large bottles"
objective.code:
model.setObjective(
    SmallBottleCapacity * SmallBottlesUsed + 
    LargeBottleCapacity * LargeBottlesUsed,
    GRB.MAXIMIZE
)

constraints.description: Number of small bottles used must be at least MinRatioSmallToLarge times the number of large bottles used
Total number of bottles used (small plus large) must be less than or equal to MaxTotalBottles
Number of large bottles used must be greater than or equal to MinLargeBottles
Number of small and large bottles used must be integers
constraints.code:
# Integrality is enforced by defining SmallBottlesUsed and LargeBottlesUsed 
# with vtype=GRB.INTEGER when creating the variables.

SmallBottlesUsed.definition: Number of small bottles used for transporting honey

LargeBottlesUsed.definition: Number of large bottles used for transporting honey
